device.type: DVB-S2 Full HD compact satellite receiver
device.soc: ALi C3503C (chip word 0x3503C000, SDK chip code 0x10050, OTP product 5)

source.author: Ferguson
source.note: Official archive A53_20190813_V1.33B7.zip from ferguson-digital.eu; fetched 2026-10-31.

simulator.note: Boots as the single-CPU C3503 family (chips/c3503.py, chip word 0x3503C000 -> SDK chip code 0x10050): its boot-ROM bootloader inherits $sp = 0x9FE07F00 from the boot ROM, calibrates DDR delay from the ring-oscillator count in the upper half of 0xB8000300 ("RingOSDelay=296.29600(ns)"), prints "CRC Check Result : Pass", and unpacks the 9.7 MB maincode to 0x80000200.  Board start-up at 0x80150EBC checks for C3503C (0x10050), OTP word 0x210 bits 20..24 carry product 5 (the DVB-S2 entry in the SDK's C3503C product table at 0x8079ED98, without which the check task at 0x805B9B60 disables GMA layer 0 every second), the internal DVB-S2 demodulator answers at 0xB804C000 and the M3031 tuner at I2C 0x20 ("M3031" on UART).  Renders its 1280x720 "System Setup" OSD menu (92 unique colours) through GMA layer 0 at 0xB8006300; board_cfg leaves its panel I2C attach pointer NULL (no LED digits on the external IR eye).

desc: Ferguson Ariva 53 official firmware V1.33B7 (2019-08-13) for the compact Full HD DVB-S2 satellite receiver on the single-CPU ALi C3503C SoC.

Pairs with the Ariva 54 (C3503D) on the C3503 family: its verbose bootloader prints DDR ring-oscillator calibration and LZMA expansion logs on UART, its board check requires chip code 0x10050 (0x3503C000) and OTP DVB-S2 product ID 5, and its external IR receiver eye has no 7-segment display.
